summary: One request ended people's lines in a campaign, which cancels their open touches there: the line counts what happened to its items, names the people whose line it ended, and carries the reason, which is required.

finished.description: Items that ended an enrolled or a held member's line.

already_finished.description: Items naming a person whose line was ended already.

not_member.description: Items naming a person the campaign never held.

excluded.description: Items naming a person removed from the campaign.

rejected.description: Items refused, each answered with its error in the response.

contact_ids.description: The people whose line was ended, in the order of the request; empty when nobody's was.
